description: This file contains a test class 'PytorchHostTests' inheriting from 'PytorchTestBase'. It includes methods for loading a machine learning model from assets for testing purposes, specifically loading a PyTorch model file stored as 'test.pt'.

classes.name: PytorchHostTests
classes.description: A test class for loading PyTorch models from assets for Android testing. It inherits from 'PytorchTestBase' and provides utility to prepare model files for testing.

methods.name: loadModel
methods.description: Loads a PyTorch model from a specified asset file path by copying it to a temporary file and then loading it via the 'Module' class.

methods.name: assetFilePath
methods.description: Creates a temporary file, copies the specified asset 'test.pt' into it, and returns the absolute path of the temp file.
